en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European city taken from an elevated vantage point, probably a hill or castle. In the foreground are trees and steeply roofed buildings; to the lower right stands a richly decorated neo‑Renaissance building with a large central dome and smaller corner domes, facing a square. Numerous church towers punctuate the dense historic roofscape beyond, with flat plains and distant low hills in the background. A small white number "656" is printed in the lower left margin.
